ethics: Public figures only. Roles and attributed public positions from linked sources. No personal phone numbers, addresses, subjective credibility rankings or fabricated social handles. Portraits require verified re-use permissions; current directory uses initials.

people.name: David Grusch
people.short: Former US intelligence officer who testified to Congress about allegations of concealed UAP programmes.
people.position: In his July 2023 opening statement, Grusch described allegations relayed to him by other individuals about classified UAP-related programmes. His statement expressly described much of this information as second-hand.
people.context: The hearing establishes what was said under oath; it does not independently confirm each underlying allegation. His claims should be traced to original records and any publicly testable evidence.

sources.label: US House Oversight hearing & witness statements

people.name: Ryan Graves
people.role: Former US Navy pilot; Americans for Safe Aerospace
people.short: A former naval aviator who has advocated for safer reporting of unidentified observations by aircrew.
people.position: Graves testified to Congress in July 2023 about pilot experiences and shortcomings in UAP reporting systems. Americans for Safe Aerospace describes its mission as safety, research and de-identified reporting.
people.context: Pilot reporting and advocacy are documented. The physical origin of specific observations requires separate evidence and should not be inferred from the number of stories reported.

sources.label: Americans for Safe Aerospace — official organisation

people.name: David Fravor
people.role: Retired US Navy commander and aviator
people.short: Former naval aviator who described the 2004 encounter commonly discussed as the 'Tic Tac' incident.
people.position: Fravor appeared before Congress in July 2023 and described his firsthand naval aviation experience concerning an unidentified observation.
people.context: The testimony documents his account. Interpreting the nature, capabilities or origin of any object requires checking independently available sensor, flight and environmental data, not just repeating media summaries.

sources.label: US House hearing and Fravor written witness material

people.name: Ross Coulthart
people.short: Australian journalist known for long-form reporting and interviews concerning UAP disclosure.
people.position: NewsNation announced Coulthart as a special correspondent in November 2023. His public reporting includes interviews with witnesses and discussion of alleged government programmes.
people.context: Journalistic interviews provide attributed accounts and leads; statements made by interviewees are not automatically independently corroborated by the broadcaster.

media.label: Reality Check: Road to Disclosure — NewsNation (YouTube)

people.name: Jeremy Corbell
people.short: Filmmaker and interview host whose work includes UAP witness accounts, imagery and investigative documentaries.
people.position: The Weaponized programme describes Corbell's work as investigative journalism and documentary filmmaking related to UAP claims and public source material.
people.context: Released footage or interview accounts should be evaluated against original context and documented source provenance. A documentary release does not itself verify a claim.

media.label: Jeremy Corbell's YouTube channel — episodes and interviews

people.name: George Knapp
people.short: Long-serving investigative reporter known for reporting on UFO claims, Nevada stories and interviews.
people.position: Weaponized identifies Knapp as its co-host and highlights his reporting about Bob Lazar, Area 51 and Skinwalker Ranch.
people.context: Interviews, documentaries and claims should be evaluated by the underlying records and independent checks. Coverage of an allegation does not establish that the allegation is fact.

media.label: Weaponized interviews and reports — official programme

people.name: Mick West
people.short: Researcher known for technical examination of unusual video and photographic claims and possible conventional explanations.
people.position: West describes his work as sceptical investigation and technical image/video analysis, with Metabunk as his principal discussion and research website.
people.context: A proposed conventional explanation should also be tested against original sensor context and alternatives. An analyst's model or reconstruction is not automatically a confirmed explanation for every witness account.
